0022600018.text: The 76ers host the New York Knicks in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, their sixth of the season. Philadelphia is 4-1, 2-1 at home, and sits first in the Atlantic and second in the East after a win in its most recent game, while New York is 1-3, 12th in the East and 2.5 games back in fourth place in the Atlantic. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle, sprain). The 76ers won the only meeting so far this season 106-100 in New York on 2026-10-20, the 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, and Philadelphia lost the 2025-26 playoff series 0-4.
